visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A white screen displays a group of simplified cartoon men with black messy hair and varying clothing styles. A large red arrow points toward a character in the middle. The background is sterile and brightly lit with high-contrast text overlays. (2) The scene cuts to a blue background showing two translucent wireframe cubes side-by-side. Inside the cubes, small arrows point left and right, then up and down, suggesting motion despite the geometric frames remaining physically static. (3) The cartoon men reappear on a white background with red numbers 1 through 12 appearing above their heads. The top half of the image shifts horizontally, and after the movement, the numbers above the characters magically increase to 13, creating a visual counting paradox. (4) A single large Chinese character '不' is displayed centered on a pink grid background. It is then replaced by a nearly identical character with subtle structural differences to challenge the viewer's perception. (5) A black and white spiral pattern occupies the entire frame, rotating rapidly to create a hypnotic optical illusion. A small red timer counts down from 15 in the center while the pattern continues to swirl. (6) An animated ending sequence features personified food items including a tomato, pineapple, and a rice bowl character labeled with a brand logo. They are gathered around a grill with skewered meat and vegetables against a dark purple background.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A clear male voice begins a professional narration with a friendly and inviting tone, speaking at a moderate pace. An upbeat electronic pop background music track starts simultaneously, featuring a steady 4/4 drum machine beat and bright synthesizer pads that maintain a positive energy. (2) A sharp digital 'whoosh' sound effect triggers as the visuals transition from the character group to the cube illusion. The narrator continues his explanation, his pitch remaining stable while the background music continues its rhythmic progression without interruption. (3) A soft digital 'ping' or 'click' sound accompanies the appearance of numbers on the screen. The narrator's speech exhibits clear articulation and high clarity as he poses a question to the audience, while the synth music provides a consistent melodic bed. (4) Another transition effect occurs as the topic shifts to the character puzzle. The audio environment remains studio-clean with a high signal-to-noise ratio, focusing primarily on the balanced mix between the informative vocal track and the driving electronic background rhythm. (5) As the hypnotic spiral appears, the background music continues its loop, but the narrator's voice lowers slightly in intensity to match the focused nature of the countdown. There is no ambient noise, only the clean digital synthesis of the music and voice. (6) The final phase introduces subtle sound design elements like a faint sizzling noise to match the animated barbecue scene. The music reaches its final loop before a hard cut at the end of the video, maintaining a professional broadcast-style quality throughout.
